## Synopsis

```text
perch account list [OPTIONS]
```

## Description

Print account ID, primary address, display name, disabled state, and creation time.

## Options

| Option | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--config <value>` | configuration file (default: ~/.config/perch/perch.yaml) |
| `--help, -h` | show help |

## Examples

```sh
perch account list
```
